label: preparing
what: An innkeeper-led civic appreciation presentation honoring municipal public service, likely the mayor, is being jointly arranged for day 1 at 18:00 in the town hall great hall. Its existence is now disclosed, but its contents are deliberately private and the mayor is instructed not to arrive early. The secretary knowingly helps by scheduling it and coordinating approval. Baker and builder have material-transfer evidence; freight and neighbour's participation is supported more tentatively by townsfolk reports of bakery gatherings.
